name: orchestrator-hooks
description: Hook suite for the orchestrator ecosystem — SessionStart/SessionEnd cleanup, SubagentStart start-stamps, SubagentStop findings/report guard covering all 7 agents (proof-of-execution for checker/reviewer/tester, presence + freshness for reader/writer/thinker/researcher, blocks with a retry reason), PostToolUse findings/report auto-context + guard, readonly-agent write confinement, writer-overlap detection, PreCompact snapshot.
